messages:
max_pm: Quick sync 0: hardware partner + SI integrations need a clearer SEV path. Yesterday the SI opened tickets in three places and we had duplicated effort. Can we make a compact policy that both sides can follow?

lucy_support: Yes please. The big things are: 1) single source-of-truth channel, 2) who owns the customer comms, 3) how handbacks work when the SI finishes config work.

omar_partner_se: From the partner side: we need an agreed channel name we can automate into our tooling. Proposal: #hw-marketplace-escalate (shared). Also request that the first poster include a single "integration-id" and a link to the SI ticket.

emily_sre: Operational idea: when someone posts in #hw-marketplace-escalate with "INTEG=<id>" the bot should do three things: 1) create private warroom #hw-war-<id>, 2) tag redwood oncall + partner oncall, 3) post the minimal triage template.

ops_bot: Trigger rule matched: message contains "INTEG=". Warroom created: #hw-war-2100123456-integ123. Zoom: https://meet.redwood/war-2100123456. Notifying @lucy_support, @omar_partner_se, @emily_sre. Triage template posted.

lucy_support: Triage template suggestion (short): 
- Customer impact (Yes/No)
- INTEG id: 
- Symptoms & first-observed time
- Last-known-good config
- Quick mitigation attempted
- Owner (org:name)

omar_partner_se: Agree. Also add a required line: "SI relay contact: <email>" so Redwood can loop in the SI POC for customer comms. We can't give internal ticket URLs, so include the public ticket stub we can reference.

emily_sre: Add escalation SLAs to the template: 
- Owner assignment: 8 minutes (default)
- SRE escalation if owner not assigned: 25 minutes
- Exec notification if unresolved: 90 minutes
We can make per-partner overrides in the config.

linda_ops: Can we codify a short handback checklist? Common failure is Redwood fixes infra but the SI still needs to validate on-customer side and close their ticket. Handback should include verification steps, artifacts to leave in the warroom (logs, commit ref, config diffs), and the closure statement the SI must post.

max_pm: Good point. Draft handback: 
- Incident resolved indicator + timestamp
- Redwood remediation summary (one-paragraph)
- SI validation checklist (pass/fail rows)
- Link to customer-facing post (template)
- Confirmation: "SI closes their ticket after validation"

lucy_support: Next actions: 1) Omar to share partner oncall email format & sample public ticket stub (ETA: 48h). 2) Emily to add the bot trigger + template to ops-bot repo (ETA: 72h). 3) Linda to draft the handback checklist in confluence and link it from the bot (ETA: EOW). 4) Max to circulate the final one-pager and run the first joint drill (ETA: next week).

omar_partner_se: We'll run a 30-minute drill with our SI team once the bot is in place.

emily_sre: I'll open the PR for the bot change today and cc the partner automation owner for testing.

ops_bot: Reminder: "HW-SI escalation drill" scheduled for 7 days.

max_pm: Thanks everyone. Aim is to make the process as low-friction as possible so customer impact is minimized and our SIs don't have to guess who to call. If you spot gaps, call them out here and I'll update the one-pager. :white_check_mark:
